title: Apply effect item effect outcome
description: Applies a mob (potion) effect on the provided entity.

effect.$comment: A resource location referencing a mob effect. Vanilla effects can be found here: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Effect

entity.$comment: The entity that the effect should be applied to.

source.$comment: The entity that the effect should be applied from. Probably relevant in cases where a mob effect would kill a player, and this source entity would be used for the kill message.

duration.$comment: The duration of the effect, in ticks.

amplifier.$comment: The amplifier of the effect, a higher value typically makes the mob effect stronger. Starts at 0 for most effects.

stackDurationCap.$comment: If provided, when this outcome is triggered and 'entity' already has the mob effect active then the effect duration will be increased by 'duration' amount up to this cap.

stackAmplifierCap.$comment: If provided, when this outcome is triggered and 'entity' already has the mob effect active then the effect amplifier will be increased by 'amplifier' amount up to this cap.

ambient.$comment: Denotes that the effect is an ambient effect in the world. Usually true for beacon effects, likely not be true for an item effect.

visible.$comment: Determines if particle effects should appear around the entity while the effect is active.

showIcon.$comment: Determines if the effect icon should appear in the player's UI while the effect is active.
